title: polyscias sandwicensis
intro: Polyscias sandwicensis, commonly known as the Island Manna, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant is native to Hawaii and has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Polyscias sandwicensis include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits, such as antioxidant and cardiovascular protective effects.
